classifications.reason: This is purely an addition to the design-system rationale documentation: it re-derives and grounds four ALREADY-FROZEN, already-owner-approved hex literals with color-science math and competitor citations. It explicitly states it changes no hex value, licenses no new token, and touches no product surface (PDP, homepage, SalonCard, booking flow, etc. are all untouched). It reads as doc-only work, one tier smaller than even a typical "small" code tweak, so it integrates directly into RATIONALE.md with no owner mockup needed. The one open item, a taste_lab_probe asking whether to formally document an on-sunken accent-text variant reusing the already-locked s-accent.deep token, is a yes/no question for QUESTIONS.md, not a build decision requiring a mockup.
